aboutMeText: I am a software engineer with over 11 years of professional experience across China and Japan. Specializing in backend systems and distributed architectures, I also bring comprehensive hands-on expertise across the entire stack—including frontend development, database optimization, cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
experienceText: From ZTE to IT consulting, I have dedicated myself to enterprise system architecture and development across China and Japan, taking on 6 key roles from 2015 to 2026.
skillsText: Backend: Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Spring Boot, Gin, Microservices; Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js; Cloud: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes; Databases: MySQL, Redis, Cassandra, MongoDB.
technicalLeadershipText: Throughout my career, alongside hands-on engineering, I have taken on technical leadership responsibilities—focusing on architectural design, technology selection, engineering standards, and team mentorship.
developmentPhilosophyText: I approach engineering challenges through a continuous Why → What → How → Why cycle.
dpWhyText: Why does the problem exist? Before proposing solutions, I identify the root cause, understand the real business and technical challenges, and clarify the constraints.
dpWhatText: What needs to be built? I evaluate potential solutions, weigh trade-offs, and assess the short- and long-term impacts before finalizing the design.
dpHowText: How should it be implemented and operated reliably? I focus on architecture, implementation details, testing strategies, observability, and operational complexity.
dpWhyAgainText: Why did the system behave unexpectedly? Post-implementation, I validate the results against original goals and continuously investigate unexpected behaviors and edge cases.
dpIterationText: Unexpected behavior is not merely a failure—it is valuable feedback. I leverage it to revisit the Why, redefine the What, refine the How, and keep the cycle evolving.
dpSummary: This structured approach helps me address root causes rather than symptoms, balancing technical excellence, business goals, and long-term system health.
aiAssistedDevelopmentText: I actively incorporate modern AI-assisted workflows across the complete development lifecycle: Requirement Analysis → Task Decomposition → Context Preparation → Architecture & Design → Implementation → Code Review → Testing → Performance Optimization.
